Overview Features Location Finance

4 Bedroom Duplex For Sale in Higgovale

Web Ref. CACB-6785
Floor size 270.00 m²
Monthly Bond Repayment
R249,594.97
Set high above the City Bowl with Table Mountain forming a spectacular backdrop, Quarry Estate offers a rare blend of privacy, greenery and contemporary luxury.

The estate enjoys an exceptional setting with far-reaching views across Lion’s Head, Signal Hill, Cape Town Harbour and the city below. Its protected position also offers welcome relief from Cape Town’s strong summer south-easter.

Perfectly placed between the City Bowl and Atlantic Seaboard, residents enjoy easy access to some of Cape Town’s best restaurants, beaches, schools, shopping and entertainment, while still returning home to a quiet and private environment.

The residences have been designed with generous proportions, abundant natural light and effortless flow between the interior and outdoor areas. Large windows, terraces and balconies make the most of the outlook, while the layouts have been carefully considered for both everyday living and entertaining.

The homes are finished to an exceptional standard, with quality materials and craftsmanship throughout.


Highlights include:

* Bespoke cabinetry and joinery
* Selected finishes and furnishings from Cecile & Boyd, Block & Chisel, Pezula and Victorian Bathrooms
* Lalegno oak flooring
* Miele appliances
* Air-conditioning
* Underfloor heating in the Triplex Condos
* Lighting by Morgan Associates
* High-quality aluminium doors and windows
* Rheinzinc roof and exterior detailing installed by specialist German craftsmen
* Striking granite feature walls using stone sourced from the original quarry and installed by specialist stonemasons


Duplex Residences:
The duplex residences are positioned below the hilltop homes and enjoy impressive views across the city and surrounding mountains.

The main living level welcomes you into a beautifully designed open-plan kitchen, dining and lounge area, all opening onto a generous balcony ideal for entertaining.

This floor also includes a dedicated drinks area, wine room, spacious scullery and guest bedroom with bathroom.

The lower level accommodates three light-filled bedrooms, all opening onto a shared balcony with wonderful views towards Signal Hill.

The result is a home that feels spacious, elegant and practical, with superb indoor and outdoor living.

Offer Rules
You will be notified of other offers via email.

All sales are non-suspensive and sold as is "voetstoots". Properties on sale with a "Offers From" price will be sold subject to confirmation of the seller.
